content.text:
I've read the release and the brief line by line. Here's what I found.

**Key facts:** Seven of the ten are stated correctly. Two are absent (commercial RPO of $678 billion, up 84%; and capex of $35,802 million versus $17,079 million — a notable omission given the balance sheet shows PP&E nearly $110 billion higher year over year). One is misstated: the brief files the $3.2 billion Anthropic gain under "OpenAI investment impact" and omits the $0.27 EPS benefit entirely. The release is explicit that Anthropic is a discrete item measured against April 29, 2026 guidance, not part of the OpenAI non-GAAP adjustment — the OpenAI impact in the quarter was a $480 million net income benefit, $0.07 per share. Conflating the two mischaracterizes both the size and the basis of the item.

**Two other problems:**

1. The brief says cash "decreased to $20.9 billion from $30.2 billion at the end of Q3." The $30.2 billion is the June 30, 2025 balance (prior fiscal year end). Q3-end cash was $32,105 million per the cash flow statement's beginning-of-period line. Wrong comparison period.

2. The brief attributes Intelligent Cloud growth to "Azure and Dynamics 365." Dynamics 365 is listed under Productivity and Business Processes in the release. The release also does not attribute segment growth to specific drivers at all.
